title: Subscribe-and-Save Miss Rate
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search order_type="subscribe_save"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(delivered_on_time="true")) as successful by _time category
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for Subscribe-and-Save deliveries by category.
value: Delivery reliability is what makes Subscribe-and-Save convenient instead of just more invisible reordering.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for Subscribe-and-Save deliveries events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for Subscribe-and-Save deliveries by category.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often Subscribe-and-Save deliveries works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
